        "standard": "/root/ratekv/mistral_profiling_results.json",
        "out_path": "/root/ratekv/artifacts/mistral_downstream_k2_results.json",
    },
]


def load_merged_profiles(hires_path, standard_path):
    with open(hires_path) as f:
        hires_raw = json.load(f)
    hires = hires_raw.get("profiles", hires_raw)

    with open(standard_path) as f:
        std_raw = json.load(f)
    std = std_raw.get("profiles", std_raw)

    merged = {}
    for l_str in sorted(hires.keys(), key=int):
        merged[l_str] = {}
        for h_str in sorted(hires[l_str].keys(), key=int):
            d2 = hires[l_str][h_str]["quantization"]["2"]
            q = {"2": d2}
            if l_str in std and h_str in std[l_str]:
                sq = std[l_str][h_str].get("quantization", {})
                for b in ["4", "8"]:
                    if b in sq:
                        q[b] = sq[b]
            merged[l_str][h_str] = {"quantization": q}
    return enforce_monotonicity(merged)


def run_eval(model, tokenizer, device, task_list, num_fewshot):
    lm = HFLM(pretrained=model, tokenizer=tokenizer, device=device, batch_size=8)
    results = lm_eval.simple_evaluate(
        model=lm, tasks=task_list, num_fewshot=num_fewshot, device=device,
    )
    scores = {}
    for task_name, task_result in results["results"].items():
        acc_key = "acc,none" if "acc,none" in task_result else "acc_norm,none"
        scores[task_name] = round(task_result.get(acc_key, 0.0), 4)
    return scores


def run_model(cfg):
    t0 = time.time()
    name = cfg["name"]
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  {name} downstream eval (k={MAX_2BIT}, budget={BUDGET})")
    print(f"{'='*60}\n")

    print("Loading merged profiles...")
    profiles = load_merged_profiles(cfg["hires_2bit"], cfg["standard"])

    mckp = solve_mckp_constrained(profiles, BUDGET, mode="quant_only",
                                   max_2bit=MAX_2BIT, l0_exclude_2bit=True)
    uniform = uniform_quantization_baseline(profiles, bits=4)

    print(f"MCKP k={MAX_2BIT}: bit_distribution={mckp.get('bit_distribution', {})}, "
          f"budget={mckp['actual_memory_ratio']:.4f}, distortion={mckp['total_distortion']:.6f}")

    print(f"Loading {name} to {DEVICE}...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(cfg["model_path"])
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        cfg["model_path"], torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation="eager"
    )
    model = model.to(DEVICE)
    model.eval()

    result = {"model": name, "tasks": TASKS, "num_fewshot": NUM_FEWSHOT,
              "max_2bit": MAX_2BIT, "budget": BUDGET}

    print("\n[1/3] Baseline (bf16)...")
    result["baseline"] = run_eval(model, tokenizer, DEVICE, TASKS, NUM_FEWSHOT)
    print(f"  {result['baseline']}")

    print("\n[2/3] Uniform 4-bit...")
    orig = patch_attention(model, uniform["allocation"])
    result["uniform_4bit"] = run_eval(model, tokenizer, DEVICE, TASKS, NUM_FEWSHOT)
    restore_attention(model, orig)
    print(f"  {result['uniform_4bit']}")

    print(f"\n[3/3] Constrained MCKP (k={MAX_2BIT})...")
    orig = patch_attention(model, mckp["allocation"])
    result["constrained_mckp_k2"] = run_eval(model, tokenizer, DEVICE, TASKS, NUM_FEWSHOT)
    restore_attention(model, orig)
    print(f"  {result['constrained_mckp_k2']}")

    result["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
    result["mckp_allocation_summary"] = {
        "bit_distribution": mckp.get("bit_distribution", {}),
        "actual_budget": mckp["actual_memory_ratio"],
        "total_distortion": mckp["total_distortion"],
    }

    print(f"\n{'Task':<20} {'Baseline':>10} {'Uniform':>10} {'MCKP-k2':>10} {'MCKP-Uni':>10}")
    print("-" * 65)
    for task in TASKS:
        bl = result["baseline"].get(task, 0)
        uni = result["uniform_4bit"].get(task, 0)
        mk = result["constrained_mckp_k2"].get(task, 0)
        delta = mk - uni
        print(f"{task:<20} {bl:>10.4f} {uni:>10.4f} {mk:>10.4f} {delta:>+10.4f}")

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(cfg["out_path"]), exist_ok=True)
    with open(cfg["out_path"], "w") as f:
        json.dump(result, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved to {cfg['out_path']}")

    del model, tokenizer
    gc.collect()
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()


def main():
    total_t0 = time.time()
    for cfg in MODELS:
        run_model(cfg)
    print(f"\n\nTotal elapsed: {time.time() - total_t0:.0f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
